title: Euphorbia peplus cream for medicinal use
intro: Euphorbia peplus cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the sap of the Euphorbia peplus plant, commonly known as petty spurge. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its potent anti-inflammatory and keratolytic properties. The cream is applied to the skin to treat conditions such as warts, corns, and other keratinous growths. Its active compounds help to soften and remove hardened skin layers. However, due to its strong effects, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist.
